signatureAbility.signatureActivationDescription: Make consecutive passes for 5+ yards in air
signatureAbility.signatureDescription: Accurate passers know that ball placement is the difference between a touchdown and a turnover. When they enter the zone, all passes are thrown with perfect accuracy.
Passers with this ability have faster passing animations when they are throwing under pressure
Passers with this ability have perfect accuracy on all throws under 40 yards while running outside the pocket (except on high/low throws).
Passers with this ability receive better pass blocking from their offensive linemen.
Passers with this ability are immune to throw penalties caused by defensive pressure while their feet are set in the pocket
Passers with this ability have faster passing speed and release the ball quicker.
Defenders with this ability will grant a bonus pass rush point to all defensive linemen on any 3rd or 4th down
Defenders with this ability can apply pressure to the quarterback from a greater distance.
Defenders with this ability can reach out of engaged blocks to tackle or sack nearby ballcarriers.
During preplay, players with this ability will highlight any oncoming blitzers on 3rd and 4th downs. Can be bluffed.
Blockers with this ability reduce a rusher's chances of using a quick block shed move while pass blocking.
Blockers with this ability gain blocker resistance points as a faster rate
Running Backs with this ability receive improved blocking from their O-Line within 5 yards of the end zone
Receivers with this ability will immediately and precisely react to a user's playmaker inputs.
Ballcarriers with this ability have steerable juke and spin animations.
After securing a RAC catch, ballcarriers with this ability can quickly shift momentum, change direction, and turn the corner without sacrificing speed.
When lined up at any wide receiver position, players with this ability have access to four additional hot routes during pre-play adjustments.
Receivers with this ability catch more consistently while catching passes 20+ yards from the LoS.
